title: Preparation of Cas9 Protein
author: Ashwin Banfal
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rczd2x6
materials: Freeze the cells at -80°C. Undetermined, Freezing cells
*Save 20 µl supernatant for SDS-PAGE: cell lysate
Next day: *Save 10 µl for SDS-PAGE: postTEV
[LOAD] Inject sample to the loop with syringe.

steps.title: Prepare Starter Culture
steps.instruction: Pick 6 colonies and add them to 20 ml LB + Amp (Cf=100 ug/ml) starter culture.

steps.title: Transform Rosetta 2 Cells
steps.instruction: Transform Rosetta 2 cells (pRAR-rare codons) with DNA.

substeps.instruction: Mix 1 µl of 10 ng/uL DNA with 10 µl Rosetta 2 cells.
Perform heat shock: 10 minutes on ice, 45 seconds at 42°C, and 5 minutes on ice.
Recover by adding 300 µl LB and shaking for 50 minutes at 37°C.
Spin down at 6000 xg for 1 minute and remove 150 µl LB.
Plate 100 µl and 30 µl on 2 AMP plates.

steps.title: Prepare Glycerol Stocks
steps.instruction: Store XL1 blue 20% glycerol stocks at -80°C the next day.

steps.title: Express Cas9 Protein
steps.instruction: Scale up culture and induce protein expression.

substeps.instruction: Add AMP to flasks (Cf=100 ug/ml).
In the morning, add 20 ml starter culture to the flasks.
Grow at 37°C and 150 rpm for approximately 4 hours until OD600=0.6.
Set shaker temperature to 16°C.
Add 0.5 mM IPTG.
Grow overnight for at least 16 hours at 16°C and 150 rpm.

steps.title: Harvest and Lyse Cells
steps.instruction: Harvest cells and perform mechanical lysis, keeping cells cold throughout the process.

substeps.instruction: Spin down cells at 4000 rpm for 20 minutes at 4°C.
Completely resuspend pellets in 20 ml Lysis Buffer + 1mM PMSF per bottle.
Use an additional 20 ml Lysis Buffer to wash all bottles and transfer to 50 ml tubes.
Place a beaker with a stir bar at the bottom of an ice bucket.
Add ~50 ml Lysis Buffer and 1 protease inhibitor tablet per 50 ml of cells; dissolve tablets.
Transfer cells to the beaker.
Sonicate while stirring: 8 minutes total (10 seconds on, 10 seconds off, level 4). Repeat 8-minute cycle if necessary until lysate is fluid and thin.
Transfer lysate to Oak Ridge tubes (30 ml/tube), balancing within +/- 0.01g.
Pellet cell debris at 18,000 rpm for 30 minutes at 4°C.

steps.title: Ni-NTA Purification (HisTrap)
steps.instruction: Purify protein using a HisTrap CV=5ml column (FR=2ml/min) with Buffer A (Lysis buffer) and Buffer B (Elution buffer).

substeps.instruction: Set up Akta: Turn on UV lamp, wash with water (pump wash and flow 50% A, 50% B), pump wash again, flow 50% A/B, then flow 100% A until baseline is steady and zeroed.
In the cold room: Fill tubing with water, connect column, wash with 5CV water, and equilibrate with 5CV lysis buffer.
Apply sample via pump. Collect flow-through (Ni-sample loading) and re-apply if necessary.
Attach column to Akta at FR=0.9 ml/min.
Wash 1: 15CV lysis buffer. Collect flow-through (Ni-wash1); save 20µl for SDS-PAGE.
Wash 2: 3CV lysis buffer + 0.1% Triton X. Collect flow-through (Ni-wash2); save 20µl for SDS-PAGE.
Wash: 5CV lysis buffer until steady UV baseline.
Elute: 25CV elution buffer using a 100% gradient. Collect fractions (size=2.5 ml).
Clean-up: Wash 5CV water, store in 5CV 20% ethanol, detach column, and wash Akta with water.

steps.title: TEV Cleavage
steps.instruction: Cleave the tag using TEV protease.

substeps.instruction: Pool appropriate fractions and rinse collection tubes with elution buffer. Save 10 µl for SDS-PAGE (Ni-elution).
Concentrate to ~3 ml volume using a 30K Amicon. Collect flow-through (Ni-Amicon FT).
Add ~1.25 mg TEV per 3 ml sample and mix with pipette.
Incubate on a shaker at 4°C overnight.

steps.title: Heparin Purification
steps.instruction: Purify protein using a Heparin CV=5 mL column (FR=1 mL/min) with Buffer A (IEX low salt) and Buffer B (IEX high salt).

substeps.instruction: Add 25 ml of buffer A to the sample.
Set up Akta (FR=2 ml/min).
In the cold room: Equilibrate with 10CV buffer A and apply sample via pump. Collect flow-through (Hep-sample loading).
Attach column to Akta (FR=0.9 ml/min).
Wash: 15CV buffer A until steady baseline. Collect flow-through (Hep-wash); save 20 µl for SDS-PAGE.
Elute: 20CV buffer B using a 100% gradient. Collect fractions (size=2 ml).
Clean-up (FR=2ml/min): Wash with buffer B until conductivity baseline is steady for >30 ml, store in 5CV 20% ethanol, detach column, and wash Akta with water.

steps.title: Final Concentration and Polishing
steps.instruction: Concentrate the sample and perform size exclusion chromatography using MBPTrap and Superdex 200 (CV=120 mL, FR=0.5-1 mL/min) with Gel filtration buffer.

substeps.instruction: Pool appropriate fractions and rinse collection tubes with buffer B. Save 10 µl for SDS-PAGE (Hep-elution).
Concentrate sample to ~1 ml and leave concentrator on ice at 4°C overnight.
Concentrate further to ~500 µl and rinse concentrator with 500 µl gel filtration buffer.
Spin down sample at 11000 rpm for 4 minutes at 4°C and transfer supernatant to a new 1.5 ml tube.

Prepare Akta (FR=2 mL/min) the previous day: Wash MBPTrap with 5CV water and 5CV gel filtration buffer in the cold room, attach MBPTrap and Superdex200, and equilibrate overnight with 2CV gel filtration buffer (FR=0.3 mL/min, end timer volume=240 mL, max pressure alarm=0.25 MPa).
Clean injection port and sample loop with water and gel filtration buffer.
Draw up sample with a 1 ml syringe and place on the injection port.
Inject sample (~3 ml), then flow ~1CV gel filtration buffer. Collect fractions (size=2 ml); Cas9 elutes at 65-85 ml.

Clean-up (FR=2 ml/min): Detach MBPTrap, wash MBPTrap with 10CV 10mM maltose + gel filtration buffer, store MBPTrap in 5CV 20% ethanol, wash Superdex200 with 2CV water (store in 20% ethanol), detach Superdex200, and wash Akta with water.

steps.title: Storage
steps.instruction: Pool appropriate fractions and rinse collection tubes. Save 5 µl for SDS-PAGE (Cas9). Snap-freeze in LN2 and store at -80°C.
